_comment: The four route talents, one per Flame Lord, each exclusive to that lord~s own path. No talent for any other character is recorded by any source checked, which is why this table has exactly four rows.

_mechanics.scope: Route talents are world map abilities that only work on the Flame Lord~s own path, which is part of why the four Part I routes play differently.
_mechanics.exclusivity: A talent cannot be borrowed by another lord: Cai cannot farm on Dietrich~s route and Theodora cannot recruit battalions on Leda~s.
_mechanics.crossLinks: Each talent feeds systems covered elsewhere on this site, so these rows connect to the battalions, farming, mounts and activities pages.

_openGaps: No talents for anyone but the four Flame Lords: no other character~s talent is recorded by any source checked.
No Spellsong detail: the upgrade is named and never quantified.
No mount or crop list: Cai~s two mechanics each lack a data table in every source checked.

talents.name: Answerer's Cry
talents.unlock: A world map command available from Part I Chapter 4.
talents.effect: Reveals randomly hidden enemies inside a circular area for two turns.
talents.reward: Defeating those enemies in a Skirmish yields Magic Echo Shards, which strengthen Combat Arts at the Smyrnos shrine, and Renown as well.
talents.limit: Repeated use narrows the area of effect. It recovers over time, or by entering and leaving bases and dungeons.
talents.bonus: Exploring also occasionally triggers duel bounty requests against a strong enemy, and winning can add Renown again and may teach a new Combat Art.

talents.name: Gambits and Battalions
talents.unlock: Recruit Soldiers on the world map, Rousing Speech from Renown 5, and the Transport Chief from Part I Chapter 7.
talents.effect: Recruits battalions from settlement nodes, which unlock the Gambit command on any infantry unit they are given to.
talents.reward: Battalions also gather materials unattended when stationed at Search nodes, and surplus ones convert into troop points towards a Tactics Manual.
talents.limit: Mounted units can never carry one, a unit can only equip a battalion at or below its own Authority, and gambits cannot be used during Clashes.
talents.bonus: Battalion quality and the number deployable at once improve at Renown 5, 7 and 9.

talents.name: Animal Mounts and Crop Farming
talents.unlock: Both are introduced by the Chapter 5 and 6 subquests.
talents.effect: Captures animal mounts and plants crops on the world map, which is where the fertiliser, Rest Spot healing and weekly Bird Time food all come from.
talents.reward: Crops trade with the Vandahl merchants for weapons and accessories and pay quest item requests.
talents.limit: Farming needs an empty pentagon tile and is gated by Renown for the number of plots.
talents.bonus: Failed captures still pay out, because they yield the fertiliser that improves rare-crop odds.

talents.name: Spellsong Performances
talents.unlock: Through the Perform tasks recorded in the sidequest list.
talents.effect: Performing at the tavern yields Renown, gold and Spellsong upgrades.
talents.reward: Renown is the account-wide stat that gates recruitment, battalions, farming plots and the Renown perks elsewhere, so a perform routine compounds.
